grades.overall_note: Overall the agent handled this well: it treated the request as one for landlord consent, put the tenant's terms to the landlord clearly, told the tenant to wait and put the ticket on hold. It fell short in three places: it never asked who pays to remove the old machine, it put off writing a note of the ownership terms instead of recording one, and it gave no safety advice for the swap.
